valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E on FY2027 diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), USD listing, no ADR conversion. Run-rate: Q3 2026 diluted EPS $1.87 (released 2026-10-13), annualized $7.48. Base FY2027 EPS $8.00 (about 7% above run-rate, consistent with Q3 net income up 6% and NII up 5%) at 11.5x, the middle of WFC's recent trading range. Bear EPS $7.00 at 10x. Bull EPS $8.80 at 13x. Cross-check on tangible book: one source gives TBVPS of about $44.46 (not confirmed against the 10-Q). With Q3 ROTCE of 16.3% and a 10.5% cost of equity, steady-state P/TBV = (16.3% - 4%) / (10.5% - 4%) = 1.89x, which at $44.46 is about $84 today and supports the base-case multiple range. Dividend: aggregate indicated rate of $2.00 a year used as the gross cash yield over the horizon.

bear.driver: Net interest income growth stalls after the Q3 margin drop to 2.43% and fee revenue misses; efficiency ratio stays near 63% and credit or regulatory costs rise; CET1 pressure limits buybacks.

base.driver: Q4 NII near the guided $13B run-rate and 2027 NII growth tracking loan and deposit growth; expenses flat-to-down as headcount falls (down 8% y/y); buybacks continue near $2.5B a quarter; ROTCE rises toward the 17% target.

bull.driver: Management reaches the 17%-18% ROTCE target sooner through fee growth and efficiency, NII beats, and faster capital return as the CET1 ratio (10.0%) allows.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $8.00 the close of $86.05 implies 10.8x. The Yahoo-aggregated analyst mean target of $97.38 (24 analysts, range $88-$108) implies about 12.2x base EPS, or EPS of about $8.45 at a constant 11.5x; the analysts' assumptions are unknown.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $8.00 (9.3 pp of price return); $0.50 of FY2027 EPS moves it by $5.75 (6.7 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Quarterly NII and ROTCE: the base case needs NII tracking the Q4 2026 guide of about $13B and ROTCE rising from 16.3% toward 17%, with noninterest expense flat-to-down.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings (date not confirmed in the sources; the aggregate's next-earnings timestamp is 2027-01-14, which should be checked against the IR calendar).

analyst_notes: Only one named 2026 call could be sourced with a date before the close: Betsy Graseck (Morgan Stanley) at $102 on 2026-06-29, undated horizon, so it sits outside the weighted target. Named post-Q3 actions (Citi cut to $88 from $90 on Oct 15, 2026; RBC to $92; Keefe Bruyette to $90 from $94; Morgan Stanley to $101) were reported in search snippets but the analyst names, dates or prior targets could not be verified, and the broker pages returned HTTP 403, so they are omitted. The Yahoo-aggregated mean of $97.38 (24 analysts) sits about 6% above the $92 base case, which implies roughly 12.2x base EPS versus our 11.5x; the gap is a multiple gap, not an earnings gap, unless analysts assume EPS near $8.45. Coverage is partial and the named panel is too thin to weight.
